dialogues.speaker: Stone Gate Bulletin Board
dialogues.text: This is the Stone Gate Bulletin Board. You can find notices and messages from passersby posted here.

dialogues.speaker: Bulletin Board
dialogues.text: Many Treasure Hoarders have been spotted recently near Stone Gate and Dihua Marsh. Passersby should take caution.

dialogues.speaker: Bulletin Board
dialogues.text: If you see anything suspicious, please first get to safety and then report the situation immediately to the nearest Millelith soldier.
